subject: Re: Redwood trial / procurement next steps & billing start
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-20T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Follow-up: trial kickoff recap + next steps

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery and the actions we agreed on: 

- Trial scope: 1M inference tokens/month across 3 product teams (Search, Support, Insights)
- Success criteria: 80% reduction in human tagging time for Support; Search relevance uplift measured by CTR on test queries; low-latency P95 under 600ms for median queries
- Procurement path: you mentioned procurement prefers purchase orders (PO) and that Marketplace is an option if it simplifies procurement — we noted both options
- Technical readiness: Rishi will follow up with SSO and network checklist items to confirm onboarding timeline

Next steps:
1) I will send a formal quote and an outline of the commercial paths (PO vs card vs marketplace) — expect that in the next message (attached).
2) Rishi will send the SSO checklist for your infra team to review.
3) Jordan to introduce procurement contact (procurement@acme.com) if available, so we can share the PO-ready quote and required compliance docs.

Proposed timeline: start trial onboarding next week; we agreed to a 30-day trial with usage tracking to evaluate the success criteria. If thresholds are met, we can transition to paid per the commercial path you choose.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping momentum.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acme.com>
Date: 2026-12-20T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: trial kickoff recap + next steps

Hi Marissa —

Appreciate the recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Procurement: yes, our default is PO. Card payments are only used for smaller purchases. If you can provide a PO-ready quote (line items + total + billing contact) that will speed things up.
- Marketplace: we do buy from AWS Marketplace for software we want consolidated on our cost center. If you can surface a Marketplace offer, that could be preferable but it needs longer approval (we'd go that route only if it doesn't delay onboarding).
- Billing start: we'd prefer billing to start when either (a) trial usage exceeds the agreed thresholds for two consecutive weeks OR (b) 30 days after trial onboarding completes — whichever comes first. Can you confirm you can automate a usage check and trigger billing?

Procurement included on cc — Suresh is our PO owner and will confirm specifics. Suresh, looping you in — can you confirm the PO contact and any mandatory fields (e.g., legal address, tax IDs)?

Happy to proceed; please send the PO-ready quote and the compliance docs.

Thanks,
Jordan
Product Ops | Acme Corp

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-20T11:28:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: trial kickoff recap + next steps

Jordan / Suresh —

Great — thanks for the details. Yes, we can support your preferred billing trigger: Redwood can enable a billing transition rule to flip from trial to paid when usage exceeds the configured thresholds for two consecutive weeks, or on the explicit date (30 days after onboarding) if that happens first. We'll include the billing trigger language in the quote so it's PO-ready.

Attached is the first-pass PO-ready quote (Redwood_Acme_Quote_v1.pdf). It includes:
- Line items for trial support and base inference unit pricing
- Options: direct invoicing (PO -> invoice), card (rare), AWS Marketplace listing (note: marketplace procurement often requires an additional 2–3 week approval window)
- Suggested billing trigger clause per your ask

I've also attached a list of compliance artifacts we typically share (SOC 2 summary, DPA link). If procurement needs anything else, let me know and we'll prioritize.

Rishi — can you confirm the SSO/network items and timeline? Laura, I'm cc'ing you to start tracking onboarding and success criteria so CS can notify Renewal when thresholds are met.

Next step: Suresh to confirm PO fields and procurement timeline; Rishi to share the SSO checklist. Once procurement confirms, we'll kick off onboarding.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Acme_Quote_v1.pdf

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-20T12:15:00-08:00
Subject: SSO + network checklist for onboarding

Hi Jordan —

Following up with the technical checklist for onboarding. Attached is a short SSO_config_checklist.xlsx that covers:
- SAML metadata and IdP endpoints we need
- SCIM provisioning requirements (optional)
- Inbound/outbound IP ranges for allowlisting
- API key/secret rotation notes and recommended KMS patterns

If your infra team can review and return the completed checklist, we can schedule a 1-hour onboarding call next week to finalize SSO and network allowlists. That call typically finishes the technical gating items and lets us spin up the trial environment.

Quick note on billing triggers: we can set up an automated usage check (we emit daily usage metrics to a monitorable endpoint). When the two-week consecutive threshold is reached we can automatically flag the account and notify both teams for billing. We will not invoice without the agreed trigger being met and sign-off from CS.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachments: SSO_config_checklist.xlsx

From: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acme.com>
Date: 2026-12-20T15:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: trial kickoff recap + next steps

Thanks everyone — this looks good.

Suresh (procurement) here — we received the quote and the billing trigger language looks fine. For the PO we need: legal entity name, billing address, tax ID, and a contact for remittance. Marissa — can you add those fields to the quote and resend?

On the billing trigger: we confirm the two-week consecutive threshold approach. For the trial-to-paid thresholds: we will consider the trial converted when total monthly inference tokens exceed 750k for two consecutive weeks AND Support team reports the tagging reduction criteria is met in the weekly check-ins. Target billing start: whichever comes first between the threshold condition or 30 days after onboarding completion.

Marketplace: we will evaluate AWS Marketplace but want to avoid delaying onboarding. If you can keep Marketplace as an optional route, we'll revisit post-trial.

Availability: procurement can review and approve the PO by 2026-12-23 if we get the updated quote today. Please send the updated PO-ready quote and I’ll route it to the procurement approver.

Jordan Smith
Product Ops | Acme Corp
